brain.required: Dole ne a cika dukkan filayen.
brain.lede: {name}: ana buƙatar ƙwaƙwalwa don yin tunani. Zaɓi ɗaya — za ka iya canza ta a kowane lokaci.
brain.offline: Ba ka kan layi. Saita ƙwaƙwalwa na buƙatar intanet, sai dai idan akwai wadda ke aiki a kan kwamfutarka tuni.
brain.quick.title: Fara da danna sau ɗaya
brain.quick.text: Shiga da OpenRouter: asusu kyauta mai ba da damar amfani da ɗaruruwan ƙwaƙwalwa, wasu kyauta.
brain.key.title: Yi amfani da makullin da kake da shi
brain.key.text: Makullinka yana kan na'urorinka, a ɓoye.
brain.key.open: Buɗe {service}, sannan ka shiga ko ka ƙirƙiri asusu
brain.key.create: Ƙirƙiri sabon makulli a can, sannan ka kwafe shi
brain.key.vertexOn: Buɗe Vertex AI a Google Cloud, sannan ka kunna shi don aikinka
brain.key.account: Buɗe Service accounts, sannan ka ƙirƙiri ɗaya mai matsayin roles/aiplatform.user
brain.key.accountKey: A cikin Keys ɗinsa, ka ƙara makulli a JSON: za a sauke fayil
brain.key.accountFile: Ka zaɓi wannan fayil a ƙasa. Yana aiki har sai ka goge makullin.
brain.local.title: A kan kwamfutarka
brain.local.text: Yi amfani da ƙwaƙwalwar da ke aiki a kan na'urarka, ta Ollama ko LM Studio.
brain.local.hint: A Ollama, ba wannan shafi izini da OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin}. A LM Studio, kunna CORS.
brain.claude.title: Yi amfani da shirin Claude ɗinka
brain.claude.text: Yana amsawa da shirin Claude Pro ko Max ɗinka, ta Claude Code, manhajar Anthropic da ke zuwa tare da shirinka: Haɗa yana girka ta a wannan kwamfutar, kuma yana sa ka shiga Claude idan ana buƙata. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda Haɗa ke buɗewa idan a kashe yake.
brain.claude.install: Babu Claude Code a wannan kwamfutar tukuna: manhajar Anthropic ce da ke zuwa tare da shirinka.
brain.claude.installing: Ana girka Claude Code daga Anthropic…
brain.claude.installFailed: Ba a iya girka Claude Code ba. Duba ko wannan kwamfutar tana kan layi, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.claude.signIn: Shiga Claude a tagar burauzar da ta buɗe, da asusun da ke da shirinka. Ka rufe ta? Haɗa zai buɗe wata.
brain.claude.signInFailed: Shiga Claude bai kammala ba. Ka sake haɗawa don sake farawa.
brain.claude.restart: “{computer}” har yanzu yana aiki da tsohon sigar. Dakatar da shi (Ctrl+C a tashar umarninsa, ko rufe manhajar), sake kunna shi, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.plan.start: “{computer}” bai fara aiki ba tukuna. Da zarar ya fara, haɗin zai kammala da kansa.
brain.copilot.title: Yi amfani da shirin Copilot ɗinka
brain.copilot.text: Yana amsawa da shirin GitHub Copilot ɗinka, ta Copilot CLI, manhajar GitHub da ke ba ka damar amfani da shirinka a wasu manhajoji: Haɗa yana girka ta a wannan kwamfutar, kuma yana sa ka shiga GitHub idan ana buƙata. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda Haɗa ke buɗewa idan a kashe yake.
brain.copilot.install: Babu Copilot CLI a wannan kwamfutar tukuna: manhajar GitHub ce da ke ba ka damar amfani da shirinka a wasu manhajoji.
brain.copilot.installing: Ana girka Copilot CLI daga GitHub…
brain.copilot.installFailed: Ba a iya girka Copilot CLI ba. Duba ko wannan kwamfutar tana kan layi, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.copilot.signIn: Shiga GitHub a tagar burauzar da ta buɗe, da asusun da ke da shirin Copilot ɗinka. Ka rufe ta? Haɗa zai buɗe wata.
brain.copilot.signInFailed: Shiga GitHub bai kammala ba. Ka sake haɗawa don sake farawa.
brain.gemini.title: Yi amfani da shirin Gemini ɗinka
brain.gemini.text: Yana amsawa da shirin Google AI Pro ko Ultra ɗinka, ta Antigravity CLI, manhajar Google da ke ba ka damar amfani da shirinka a wasu manhajoji: Haɗa yana girka ta a wannan kwamfutar, kuma yana sa ka shiga da Google idan ana buƙata. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda Haɗa ke buɗewa idan a kashe yake.
brain.gemini.install: Babu Antigravity CLI a wannan kwamfutar tukuna: manhajar Google ce da ke ba ka damar amfani da shirinka a wasu manhajoji.
brain.gemini.installing: Ana girka Antigravity CLI daga Google…
brain.gemini.installFailed: Ba a iya girka Antigravity CLI ba. Duba ko wannan kwamfutar tana kan layi, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.gemini.signIn: Shiga da Google a tagar burauzar da ta buɗe, da asusun da ke da shirinka. Ka rufe ta? Haɗa zai buɗe wata.
brain.gemini.signInFailed: Shiga da Google bai kammala ba. Ka sake haɗawa don sake farawa.
brain.chatgpt.title: Yi amfani da shirin ChatGPT ɗinka
brain.chatgpt.text: Yana amsawa da shirin ChatGPT Plus ko Pro ɗinka: kana shiga ChatGPT ka ba da izinin amfani da shi a nan, kuma saitunan ChatGPT na nuna yawan amfanin. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda ke ajiye shigar a wannan kwamfutar kuma yana buɗewa da farko idan a kashe yake.
brain.chatgpt.declined: ChatGPT bai ba da izinin amfani da shirinka ba. Don ba da izini, sake ci gaba da ChatGPT.
brain.chatgpt.failed: Shiga ChatGPT bai yi nasara ba. Sake gwadawa.
brain.device.text: Na sirri, kyauta, kuma yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba: babu abin da ka rubuta da zai bar wannan kwamfuta.
brain.device.progress: {done} cikin {total}. Za ka iya ci gaba da amfani da wannan shafi.
brain.sameText: Ƙwaƙwalwa ɗaya, a siga ɗaya, don kowane saƙo
brain.onlyText: Babu abin da ka rubuta da zai bar wannan kwamfuta
brain.gemini.billed: An kunna biyan kuɗi a aikin Google Cloud na wannan makullin, ko kana amfani da shi daga Yankin Tattalin Arzikin Turai, Birtaniya ko Switzerland
brain.gemini.billedHint: To Google ba ta taɓa horar da AI da abin da wannan ƙwaƙwalwa take karantawa ba, don haka za ta iya karanta abin da Gmail da sauran ayyukan Google suka kawo.
brain.versionHint: Atomatik na amfani da Mai sauri, Mai wayo ko Mafi kyau gwargwadon bukatar kowane saƙo. Idan kai da kanka ka zaɓi {brain}, yana amsawa da wannan siga:
auto.both: {brain}, gwargwadon bukatar kowane saƙo, da wannan na’urar don duk abin da ke na sirri
auto.mix.lessText: Ƙwaƙwalwa mafi sauri ga kowane saƙo, hawa mataki ɗaya kawai idan amsa ba ta isa ba
auto.mix.balancedText: Ƙwaƙwalwa mai sauri don gajerun tambayoyi, mafi ƙarfi idan aiki ya buƙata
auto.mix.bestText: Ƙwaƙwalwa mafi ƙarfi ga duk abin da ya wuce gajeren tambaya, tana tunani mai zurfi
auto.personal: Duk abin da ke na sirri
auto.offline: Lokacin da ba ka da intanet
auto.steps: A cikin aiki ɗaya, Atomatik na hawa mataki ɗaya idan amsa ba ta isa ba, kuma ba ya sake saukowa; sabon aiki yana farawa daga ƙasa kuma.
